body.name: fully empirical collection profiler
body.construction: For each \(\theta\in[-1,1]\), compute \(\widehat p_s(x)\), randomized-arm means of \(Y-\theta D\), and arm empirical variances. An arm mean with zero observations is defined to be zero; an empirical arm variance is computed with the arm-count divisor when the count is at least two. Let \(\widehat q_{sx}(\theta)\) be the corresponding plug-in cell price, replace it by \(8/e_0\) when either arm count is below two, and floor every other computed value at \(N^{-1/2}\). Define \(\widehat a(\theta)\) as the unique minimizer of \(\sum_{s,x}a_{sx}^2\widehat q_{sx}(\theta)/\{n_s\max(\widehat p_s(x),N^{-1})\}\) over \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{coll}}(p_T,\mathcal H)\).
